rows.ja: 鉄鉱石の合弁相手(シマンドゥ・ピルバラ)
銅・アルミの合弁相手

companies.name: チャイナルコ(中国アルミ)

relations.text: ギニアのシマンドゥ鉄鉱山の提携相手
relations.text_en: Partner in the Simandou iron ore project in Guinea

source.label: Rio Tinto 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: In November, I joined the celebrations to mark first ore at Simandou in Guinea. This massive achievement was made possible by a unique partnership, consisting of the Government of Guinea, Chinalco, Baowu and WCS.

relations.text: 豪州Western Range鉄鉱山の合弁相手
relations.text_en: JV partner in Australia's Western Range mine

source.label: Rio Tinto 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: we opened the Western Range iron ore mine in Australia, which we developed with our joint venture partner China Baowu Group

companies.name: ウィニング・コンソーシアム・シマンドゥ

relations.text: シマンドゥの鉄道・港湾を共同開発

source.label: Rio Tinto 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: In November, I joined the celebrations to mark first ore at Simandou in Guinea. This massive achievement was made possible by a unique partnership, consisting of the Government of Guinea, Chinalco, Baowu and WCS.

relations.text: チリのNuevo Cobre銅プロジェクトを共同で探鉱
relations.text_en: Partner in the Nuevo Cobre copper project in Chile

source.label: Rio Tinto 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: we advanced the drill program and early studies at the Nuevo Cobre project in Chile, in partnership with Codelco.

companies.name: ファースト・クォンタム・ミネラルズ

relations.text: La Granja銅プロジェクトの合弁
relations.text_en: La Granja copper project joint venture

source.label: Rio Tinto 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: In August 2023, we completed a transaction to form a joint venture with First Quantum Minerals (FQM) that will work to unlock the development of the La Granja project

relations.text: フィンランドの低炭素アルミ構想Arctialの提携相手
relations.text_en: Partner in the Arctial low-carbon aluminium study in Finland

source.label: Rio Tinto 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: Partnership agreement with the Swedish investment company Vargas, Mitsubishi Corporation and other international and local industry partners to study a low carbon aluminium greenfield opportunity in Finland.
